experiment.hypothesis: The measured 20.3345% weighted attention reduction from the exact five-layer proxy lowers complete-request service time enough to justify a later quality-recovery program.
experiment.first_call: Claim the retained H200 and run one matched profiler-off stock-control/candidate exact-c32 endpoint pair through the real request, cache, scheduler, model-forward, sampling, and response path.

workload.request_ownership: Use one immutable exact 32-request fixture for both arms, preserving request-major ownership, raw token IDs, seeds, sampling parameters, cache accounting, and arm order in the terminal.

required_evidence: source-complete candidate materialization and transformed-weight manifest tied to the component spec
exact checkpoint, image, runtime, request-fixture, control, candidate, and intervention content hashes
32 complete requests per arm with zero failures, finite nonempty text, raw token IDs, usage fields, finish reasons, and exact prompt/output/cache accounting
batch wall time, service seconds per request, output tokens per second, TTFT and decode distributions for both arms
candidate/control service-time reduction and each arm normalized against both the qualified denominator and campaign target
CUDA invocation, peak HBM, and proof that the candidate endpoint path—not stock fallback—executed
all server and worker processes stopped and the bench released

classification.positive: Candidate complete-request service seconds per request is lower than the matched control with all validity fields passing.
classification.negative: A valid matched pair shows no service-time reduction.
classification.invalid: Either arm lacks 32 complete requests, exact ownership/accounting, candidate-path execution, or cleanup/release evidence.

experiment.typed_failure: If integration cannot reach a valid pair inside the budget, persist the first irreducible source, runtime, model-load, candidate-activation, request, or consumer field with exact logs and hashes in the same terminal; do not create a repair project.

budgets.wall_clock: Claim no later than 2026-07-25T20:30:00Z and release no later than 2026-07-25T21:05:00Z.
